class: A CI workflow limited by a path filter to the files of one layer never runs when a change lands only in a layer that layer imports; the dependency change breaks its tests on main with no red check anywhere, and every later PR that does touch the filtered paths inherits failures it did not cause.
mechanism: app-tests.yml triggers only on backend/ofo_app/**, tests_app/** and a few files; W-060 (commit c5873ce) changed backend/ofo/instruments and backend/ofo/marketdata/kite_provider.py, which tests_app imports. The app suite did not run on that PR or on main, so 7 app tests went red unseen.

first_seen.where: main at 6448b47 (after W-060), found by the W-062 builder
first_seen.evidence: python -m pytest -c pytest-app.ini tests_app/test_kite_ws.py tests_app/test_catalogue_store.py on main: 7 failed, 19 passed - KeyError no Kite token for 'INDEX:NIFTY 50' (6), catalogue migration segments lack NSE_INDEX/BSE_INDEX (1); gh run list --workflow app-tests.yml: last runs only on build/W-061-save-draft, none for W-060

fix: The app-tests workflow also triggers on every path the app imports (backend/ofo/**); the 7 failures are fixed on main (test ids follow W-060's NSE_INDEX identity; the catalogue migration gains NSE_INDEX/BSE_INDEX, W-060 AC-1).

detection.note: Becomes guarded when the path filter includes backend/ofo/** and a test asserts that every top-level package tests_app imports is covered by the workflow's path filter (red-then-green: remove backend/ofo/** and the test fails).

occurrences.evidence: 7 app tests red on main, no app-tests run for the W-060 PR
